themes.name: Affordable Housing and Renovation
themes.rule: Proposals that increase, preserve, finance, make transparent, or improve the energy efficiency of residential housing, including student housing and tenant rent information.

themes.name: Education and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals concerning school staffing, class conditions, facilities, academic support, meals, or extracurricular instruction for children and pupils.

themes.name: Healthcare and Care Services
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical access, preventive health services, mental-health support, emergency medical response, or care for older residents.

themes.name: Public Transit and Active Travel
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus availability, fares, rider information, cycling infrastructure, or other routine ways residents travel without private cars.

themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make municipal information or services accessible through online tools, digital assistance, public internet, open data, or a unified service-contact channel.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability and Green Space
themes.rule: Proposals focused on renewable energy, waste reduction and recycling, pollution monitoring, street trees, nearby green spaces, or community food-growing land.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, require local hiring, reduce barriers for businesses, provide business finance, or supply workspace for independent workers.

themes.name: Culture, Recreation and Community Places
themes.rule: Proposals that provide cultural events or access, public art, libraries, playgrounds, dog areas, or other neighborhood recreation and gathering amenities.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety and Protection
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce crime or physical danger through policing, surveillance, lighting, traffic calming, or faster fire and ambulance station coverage.
